articles.availability_note: MIT reported this work on November 5; the cited author preprint was submitted June 6, 2026. The 92.3% result measures initially uncertain objects crossing a selected uncertainty threshold. Question accuracy is a separate benchmark measure: 71.1% to 76.1% versus original DAAAM, and 74.3% for the strongest alternative. Long-horizon location error worsened in one comparison. Independent replication, product performance and safe physical action remain separate tests.
